prompt: The couple from the two provided photos on their wedding day, faces and hair only, everything else new. Wide shot from across a quiet British high street: a small wedding party on the steps of a plain civic building, and in the centre the couple, small in the frame, coming down the steps hand in hand through a burst of confetti thrown by a handful of friends. She in a simple cream dress, he in a grey suit. Wet pavement, one parked car, a grey sky. Documentary photograph, muted colour, fine grain. No signs, no lettering.
